title: The Loyal Salute
moral: Loyalty and teamwork make us stronger.

story: Captain Mina sailed the Sea-Sparrow with her crew and wished to honor the lighthouse that guided her. Along the journey, they explored a cave, faced tricky winds and fog, and overcame a playful storm together. Through teamwork and courage, they stayed strong. When they returned, Mina saluted the lighthouse, showing loyalty and respect. The crew sailed forward, knowing that loyalty and teamwork would guide them always.
